name: Pixeldrain
description: Resolves Pixeldrain links through the provider's public API; an optional API key lifts the free tier's limits.

codes.pixeldrain.account_required: Pixeldrain serves this file only to a signed-in account
codes.pixeldrain.api_key_invalid: Pixeldrain rejected this account's API key. It may have been revoked or expired.
codes.pixeldrain.api_key_missing: This Pixeldrain account has no API key stored
codes.pixeldrain.captcha_required: Pixeldrain asks for a captcha for this file, which this plugin cannot answer
codes.pixeldrain.direct_link_foreign: Pixeldrain named a download address outside its own domains
codes.pixeldrain.file_blocked: Pixeldrain has blocked this file and does not serve it
codes.pixeldrain.file_not_found: This file does not exist on Pixeldrain any more
codes.pixeldrain.ip_rate_limited: Pixeldrain's download limit for this connection is reached. Waiting.
codes.pixeldrain.too_many_downloads: Pixeldrain allows no further download from this connection at the moment. Waiting.
codes.pixeldrain.transfer_limit: Pixeldrain's transfer limit for this file is reached. A Pixeldrain premium subscription on either side lifts it.
codes.pixeldrain.unsupported_link: This is not a Pixeldrain file address
